description: Make the selected Ollama planner application-level local-only by validating the configured endpoint as loopback and scrubbing cloud credentials/base URLs from queued Aider subprocess environments while retaining explicit OpenAI behavior.
steps: In controller/main.py, keep PLANNER_PROVIDER as the explicit openai/ollama selector and normalize OLLAMA_API_BASE without query or fragment; accept only localhost or loopback IP forms used by the local server and reject non-local URLs before constructing the planner client.

Ensure the Ollama OpenAI-compatible client receives only the local /v1 base URL and the queued Aider command uses the Ollama model, with provider_environment removing inherited cloud credentials/base URLs by passing only a small safe process-environment allowlist and setting the validated Ollama base explicitly.
Preserve the OpenAI path and Generate's separate Anthropic path; do not alter generated-app files or broaden the feature into OS/firewall/network policy.
acceptance_criteria: PLANNER_PROVIDER=ollama with a public or non-loopback OLLAMA_API_BASE raises PlannerConfigurationError before a client or subprocess is created.
Loopback Ollama values produce a normalized local /v1 planner endpoint and ollama_chat model without requiring an OpenAI key.
The Ollama Aider environment contains the validated local Ollama base and none of the configured cloud credentials or cloud base URLs, while OpenAI mode still uses its selected key.
findings: Iteration 2 review fixes expanded Ollama Aider isolation from a finite denylist to a deliberate safe process-environment allowlist. The focused test now asserts that OpenAI, Azure, Anthropic, Google/Gemini, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Mistral, Cohere, Groq, Together, xAI, AWS/Bedrock, and Aider credential/base variables are not inherited, while PATH and HOME remain available and the validated OLLAMA_API_BASE is set. OpenAI mode remains unchanged. Verification from /Users/antoniociolino/voice-developer: controller/venv/bin/python -m unittest controller.test_planner_provider (15 tests, OK); controller/venv/bin/python -m py_compile controller/main.py controller/test_planner_provider.py (OK); git diff --check -- controller/main.py controller/test_planner_provider.py (no errors). The documented loopback-only smoke also passed with cloud variables unset and PYTHON_DOTENV_DISABLED=1, printing provider Ollama / local-only and endpoint http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1. This is application-level enforcement for the planner/Aider boundary, not OS-level proof that unrelated processes made no network connections and not a firewall/router guarantee. No generated-app files were edited and no cloud model was requested.
